title: striped pool towel
text: striped pool towel. These are very lovely towels... I purchased to make lounge chair covers (sewing 2 together with a pocket at the top).  They washed and dried up nicely.  They are not terribly long... but long enough.  I mean, I do have some extra large bath sheets that are longer and wider... but these work.  They are very soft after washing.  The blue is as shown in the photos... a medium blue with white stripe.  They are terry and a few loops have pulled, but I expected that as with any "terry" type towel.  I may purchase again if I catch a good price.

product_metadata.title: Large Turkish Beach Towel, Pool Towel with Cabana Stripe, Eco Friendly, 100% Turkish Cotton (30x60 inches) by Turkuoise Towel (Yellow)
features: Set includes four oversized beach towels at 30”x60”

Towel density is 650 grams per square meter (GSM). The weight of a towel is a great indicator of quality and performance. This 650 GSM-density towel will soak up water fast for noticeable absorbency, and dry quickly so you can enjoy your time in the sun.
Woven with 100% Turkish Cotton to enhance absorbency; these towels are specially combed to remove all but the finest and longest fibers, making these towels the ultimate in luxury and performance.
Beautiful Beach and Summer Colors – Each of our cabana towels oversized sizes feature rich, vibrant colored stripes to better match your individual style.

Stronger, Reinforced Edges – We added a thicker, more durable border to our large beach towels to help enhance their resilience after multiple day trips and heavy machine washes, so you never have to worry about fraying or loose threads.
description: Have you been looking for high quality and lush towels at an economical price? If so, you have landed on the right Listing! These 4 Large Pool Towels (30x60 inches) are imported from Turkey, a country that is famous for its high quality textiles and towels. The towels are made of 100% absorbent cotton and do not contain any harmful dyes. No dangerous chemical solvents are used in post production. In fact, we are certified by an external regulator. These premium towels are VAT dyed, which is a safe and durable process of dying in which yarns are held under a high temperature and pressure for 6-12 hours. This way, the pigment can be really steeped and infused into the towel which limits any fading and improves the overall durability of the product. We do not use any bleach when washing these towels. Customer Satisfaction is Guaranteed or your Money Back! We deeply value our customers and we are confident in our product. If you are not satisfied with these towels for any reason at all, just return them hassle-free through Amazon within 30 days for a full refund.
